Patrick van Kessel, Adam G Hughes, Nick Judd, Rachel Blum, Brian Broderick Solomon Messing (2017). Partisan Conflict and Congressional Outreach. *Pew Research Center*.

## Abstract

Partisan criticism generates most engagement in social media; most liberal and conservative legislators, party leadership more likely to `go negative'
